notes: One schema, answered verbatim by both backends. The tier question is the routing decision; the two noul questions are secondary flags. Two options only: the upstream study measured middle-tier recall at 0.13 on the base checkpoint.
state_hint: The state is a short description of the work a step is about to perform, plus any history the caller wants considered.

tier.instructions: Which tier should perform this step?

criteria.economy: The step is bounded and the target is already known: a mechanical edit, a version or dependency bump, a documentation or comment change, a test for behaviour that already exists, a release, a lookup, or a command to run. A small model one-shots it without exploring.
criteria.frontier: The step needs exploration before it can be done: designing something whose shape is not decided yet, debugging across components, a change whose blast radius makes an early wrong move expensive, or an open-ended loop of many tool calls.

needs_tools.instructions: To finish this step, does the agent have to act outside its own context — edit files, run commands, call an API or look something up — rather than reasoning over text already provided?

sensitive.instructions: Is this step irreversible, destructive, or credential-bearing: publishing a release or artifact, force-pushing or rewriting history, deploying, rotating or touching secrets, moving money, deleting data, or running untrusted code on a primary machine?
